test.name: Refuses ExplanationOfBenefit without identifier
test.description: C4BB ExplanationOfBenefit Outpatient Institutional requires ExplanationOfBenefit.identifier (at least 1); base FHIR leaves it optional. Without it the resource is refused.

test.name: Refuses ExplanationOfBenefit whose identifier does not fill slice uniqueclaimid
test.description: C4BB ExplanationOfBenefit Outpatient Institutional requires slice ExplanationOfBenefit.identifier:uniqueclaimid. A identifier value no slice matches leaves the slice empty and the resource is refused.

test.name: Refuses ExplanationOfBenefit with more than 1 identifier:uniqueclaimid
test.description: C4BB ExplanationOfBenefit Outpatient Institutional allows at most 1 of slice ExplanationOfBenefit.identifier:uniqueclaimid. 2 are refused.
